memberdef.name: ElasticitySolver

detaileddescription.para: Constructor. With with_enlarged_psi the presolver also carries the enlarged Cahn-Hilliard marker psi as an extra finite-element field (hybrid mode: analytic phi source, psi FE unknown), so the presolved mesh matches the equilibrium of the enlarged CHNS-ALE solver. The physical tracer phi stays analytic. The CHNS handoff copies the mesh position and, for the enlarged solver, the reconstructed psi field. An optional reference triangulation is borrowed and must outlive the solver. Its topology and reference vertices are left unchanged.

inbodydescription.para: Cahn-Hilliard moving-mesh forcing. The compression forcing is steep, so its multiplier is ramped from a small fraction up to its physical value (1) with a continuation method. The user-source multipliers are disabled.
Continuation method to handle possibly steep source terms evaluated on the current (deformed) mesh.

detaileddescription.para: Return the nonzero constraints of the derived solver, that is, the inhomogeneous boundary conditions and constraints on the dofs.
Create the volume and boundary assemblers for this solver.
Solve the linear system described by the assembly functions above.
Assemble the Jacobian matrix of the nonlinear problem, that is, its linearization at the current solution. This function is overloaded by each derived solver.
Assemble the (negative of the) nonlinear residual -NL(U), evaluated at the current solution. This function is overloaded by each derived solver.
Write the final deformed mesh in Gmsh format while preserving the entities and physical groups from the input mesh.

Try to load the presolved mesh position from the disk cache. The cache is keyed by support-point location (so it is reusable with a different number of MPI processes) and guarded by a fingerprint of the presolver-defining parameters. In reuse mode, returns true on success and false when the caller must recompute the presolved fields. Reads the mesh and sets up the DoFs as a side effect.
Write the presolved mesh position to the disk cache.
Canonical fingerprint of all parameters that affect the presolved mesh position, used to invalidate a stale cache. Requires the DoFs to be set up.
